contexts: about 900 admissions a year of people experiencing homelessness
city housing-first programme with direct hospital referral
reading: A referral works only if it is complete, reaches a named housing worker before discharge and survives the first days after discharge; each failure point is visible in either hospital or provider data, but not both. Engagement with services drives both referral and later hospital use, so outcome comparisons need an eligible non-referred group and a negative control. Trust decides whether referred people will talk about what happened and allow their data to be linked.

nodes.label: Complete referral before discharge
nodes.detail: Missing documents and early discharge block it (claim c3).

nodes.label: Housed within six months
nodes.detail: Quantitative primary outcome, held by the provider.

nodes.label: Engagement with services
nodes.detail: Confounds referral and later hospital use (claim c4).

summary: Map follows a referral from the ward to a tenancy and shows where each strand sees it.
